clues.it: Ugo era nella 5ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a ovest di Tea.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 5th column, in the 1st row and west of Tea.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 2ª riga, accanto a una sputacchiera e a nord di Luca.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 2nd row, beside a spittoon and north of Luca.

clues.it: Carla era su una sputacchiera, ma non era accanto a una sella.
clues.en: Carla was on a spittoon, but was not beside a saddle.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 4ª riga, ma non era accanto a una sella.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 4th row, but was not beside a saddle.

clues.it: Luca era in Banca, ma non era accanto a una sella.
clues.en: Luca was in the Bank, but was not beside a saddle.

clues.it: Giada era nella 3ª colonna e nella 6ª riga, ma non era accanto a un barile di whisky.
clues.en: Giada was in the 3rd column and in the 6th row, but was not beside a whiskey barrel.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a un cactus e a ovest di Carla.
clues.en: Nino was beside a cactus and west of Carla.

clues.it: Vito era nella 1ª colonna e accanto a una sputacchiera, ma non era accanto a un cactus.
clues.en: Vito was in the 1st column and beside a spittoon, but was not beside a cactus.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 9ª riga e accanto a una sella.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 9th row and beside a saddle.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Anna era a ovest di Sergio e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Anna was west of Sergio and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Tea era nella 8ª colonna e nelle Stalle, ma non era accanto a una sella.
clues.en: Tea was in the 8th column and in the Stables, but was not beside a saddle.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 12ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 12th.

steps.it: Solo Carla può stare nella 3ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 10ª è sua.
steps.en: Carla is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 10th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Nino più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Nino's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 7th, column 2nd.
